correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed 314928 Petersen discrete Morse rooted-forest faces from 30 oriented incidences with exact 10-degree face vector (1,30,390,2880,13305,39882,77640,94800,66000,20000). Exhaustively reconstructed 157259 staged match pairs, 410 critical faces (77 dim7, 333 dim8), acyclic orientation of all 2099520 Hasse covers. Independently computed exact signed 77×333 Morse differential, 235 nonzero ±1 coefficients, and verified 39 integral unimodular pivots leave a zero residual. Since the 7-skeleton is 6-connected wedge of 77 S7, Hurewicz and cell slides cancel 39 cell pairs, giving 38 S7 and 294 S8.

value.rationale: The Petersen ordinary Morse complex is a canonical rooted-forest topology object; upgrading established mod-2 Betti numbers to integral torsion-free homotopy type by a nontrivial attaching-matrix certificate is a substantive exact invariant and clarifies the gap between field homology and homotopy.

final_claim: The ordinary discrete Morse complex of the Petersen graph is homotopy equivalent to a wedge of 38 7-spheres and 294 8-spheres over integers.
limitations: Certificate is exact for one finite Petersen graph; 314928 full faces checked and 39 integral pivots, no family-wide result.
Older unpublished/unindexed integral computations may exist; published mod-2 result is acknowledged.
